module_summary: AXI-stream width adapter; in this 8-to-32-bit elaboration the upsize branch packs input beats into output segments via a segment counter, a one-beat input skid register and a registered output word.

anchors.name: upsize.seg_reg
anchors.why: Segment index selecting output lane to fill; wraps on last segment or tlast

anchors.name: upsize.m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Wide output word assembled segment by segment from input beats

anchors.name: upsize.m_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Output word valid, set when final segment written, gates output register load

anchors.name: upsize.s_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer holding input beat while output register is full

anchors.name: upsize.s_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer occupied flag; selects buffer versus direct input and drives tready

anchors.name: upsize.m_axis_tkeep_reg
anchors.why: Output byte enables assembled per segment

anchors.name: upsize.s_axis_tlast_reg
anchors.why: Buffered tlast ending the output word early

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready, low while skid buffer full

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready allowing output register refill

groups.name: Upsize packing control
groups.description: Segment counter and valid flags sequencing input beats into wide word

groups.name: Input skid buffer
groups.description: One-beat buffer capturing input while output register is busy

groups.name: Output word register
groups.description: Wide output register written segment by segment
